pedagogical_depth.justification: Every lesson includes a full expanded_walkthrough naming a specific Grade-1 trap (rule-drift, no-cross tally, not-one-to-one pictograph, position-not-count ordering, personal-not-data conclusion), with teacher_script, common_misconceptions, and recovery_moves. The summative rubric covers all 5 expectations on Ontario's 4-level scale with detailed level descriptors.

instructional_balance.justification: Each lesson follows the Ontario minds_on / action / consolidation arc with explicit duration_minutes (12 + 25 + 13 = 50 min). Action structure 'whole_group_then_centres' (and 'individual' for capstone) gives floor-vs-desk balance. Three rotating stations of 7 min each. Differentiation tiers explicit per lesson.

clarity_communication.justification: Voice is consistent across lessons: Detective Dot + Tally anchor every minds-on; vocabulary introduced/reinforced is named explicitly; success_criteria use child-friendly 'I can' phrasing; teacher_script is concrete with quoted dialogue. Worksheets use child-voice instructions.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes (D1.1-D1.5) mapped lesson-by-lesson via expectation_lesson_map. Each lesson's primary_expectations align to blueprint codes. The summative rubric covers all 5 expectations with descriptors that match blueprint.curriculum_expectations text exactly. Image-text alignment validation passes with 0 issues.

appearance.justification: Composite generation passes 0 placeholders thanks to the smart_fallback composer + DOT and TALLY entries already in _CHARACTER_CLIPART. All worksheet/manipulative images have well-described visual_layout and placement specs. Pre-grade drift check: 0 consistency issues, 0 curriculum issues, 0 image-text issues, 0 placeholders.
